rules: Absolute value is not injective without a sign restriction.
Piecewise maps require every branch and boundary to be covered.
Search for a witness on each branch.
log requires a strictly positive argument.
exp has strictly positive range.
Check both inverse composition and transformed bound coverage.
sinh is bijective on the real line but cosh is not without a branch restriction.
tanh has open range (-1,1).
Check branch and range constraints explicitly.
Reciprocal maps exclude zero and split positive and negative branches.
Reversing an inequality depends on the sign domain.
Check excluded points and unbounded limits.
Sigmoid and logistic maps have open range (0,1).
Logit requires an input strictly between zero and one.
Closed endpoint constraints are not preserved automatically.
Softplus has strictly positive range.
Its inverse requires a positive input.
Zero lower bounds may introduce a missing boundary point.
Even powers lose sign unless the source domain fixes a branch.
Square root requires a nonnegative radicand and returns a nonnegative value.
Check endpoint and branch coverage.
Require equality of feasible sets in both directions under one consistent variable map.
Require objective values and optimization direction to agree after substitution.
A single domain, range, bound, constraint, or objective counterexample proves non-equivalence.

claim_boundary: Authored generic nonlinear-equivalence knowledge; not automatically acquired and not fitted to NLEquiv labels.

theory.admission: all cards state necessary equivalence obligations or transform domain/range facts
theory.failure_witness: one violated necessary obligation suffices for non-equivalence
